name: get_k8s_rollout_status
description: Checks the current rollout status of a Kubernetes resource. This is similar to running `kubectl rollout status`.

parameters.description: Request for checking rollout status of a Kubernetes resource.

name.description: Required. The name of the resource to check.

namespace.description: Optional. The namespace of the resource. If not specified, "default" is used for namespace-scoped resources.

parent.description: Required. The cluster to check rollout status in. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{cluster}

resourceType.description: Required. The type of resource to check. e.g. "deployment", "daemonset", "statefulset".
